Card Q&A.q: When an effect plays an opponent's Digimon into the breeding area, does this card's inherited effect activate?
Does this card's inherited effect also activate when one of my effects plays an opponent's Digimon?

Effect: [On Play] Until the end of your opponent's turn, 1 of their Digimon gains "[On Deletion] Lose 1 memory."
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When an effect plays an opponent's Digimon, gain 1 memory.
